name.en-US: Collations on the Gospel of John
name.pt-BR: Colações sobre o Evangelho de João

description.la: Collationes in Evangelium Ioannis, ad capita Evangelii dispositae. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Opera omnia VI, 1893), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: Bonaventure’s collations on the Gospel of John, arranged by the chapters of the Gospel. The Latin is the Quaracchi edition (Opera omnia VI, 1893) from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Colações sobre o Evangelho de João.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Opera omnia, tom. VI (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1893), pp. 533-634.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates) of the folio edition. Each page is read in two columns; marginal notes, running heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings, cross-references) and small-type notes are removed by layout (line pitch and measure); line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain. Chapters are cut at the page whose running head names them.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1893 is public domain.
